decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to use the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana and play expensive and powerful threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. The deck includes various ways to search for the UrzaTron lands or the necessary pieces (Sylvan Scrying, Ancient Stirrings, Expedition Map) to ensure consistency. The deck also includes control elements like Oblivion Stone, Dismember, and Warping Wail to deal with opponent's threats. Overall, the deck aims to control the game until it can play its high-cost threats.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to play Primeval Titan early and efficiently. The main goal is to fetch important lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The Mycosynth Gardens to set up powerful combos for massive damage. With the help of Urza's Saga and Tolaria West for tutoring, the deck aims to create a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with a well-timed Cultivator Colossus or The One Ring for the win.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and played at the right moment to combo off and win the game. The key strategy involves using cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to generate value and control the board, while using Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to fetch specific creatures from the deck. The deck also includes sacrifice outlets like Delighted Halfling and Blood Artist to create additional value and close out the game.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with efficient counter spells. Creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide fast, evasive threats, while Murktide Regent serves as a powerful finisher. The deck also utilizes card selection spells like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to maintain card advantage. With a mix of burn spells, counterspells, and efficient threats, this deck aims to close out games quickly while keeping the opponent on their back foot.

This deck focuses on casting spells with cascade, allowing you to cast additional spells for free from your deck. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, you can overwhelm your opponent with a continuous stream of threats. With a mix of removal spells and powerful creatures, you can control the board while applying pressure to your opponent. The combination of aggro strategies and cascade mechanics creates a fast-paced and unpredictable gameplay experience, making it a challenging deck for your opponent to counter effectively.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with unique abilities that can be tutored for using cards like Chord of Calling. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician serves as a powerful engine for creature removal and card draw, while Grist, the Hunger Tide provides value by creating tokens. The deck also includes cards like Endurance for graveyard hate and Blood Artist for incremental life drain. The toolbox of creatures and the combo potential of the deck allow for various lines of play and adaptability to different matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to use cards like Architects of Will, Street Wraith, and Grief to cycle through your deck and put creatures into your graveyard. You can then use cards like Violent Outburst and Living End to mass reanimate all your creatures from the graveyard, overwhelming your opponent with a sudden board presence. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Negation and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect your combo pieces and disrupt your opponent's game plan. It aims to control the game until it can successfully execute its combo and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The key concept of this deck is to maintain aggressive pressure on the opponent using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Force of Negation. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by quickly deploying threats and protecting them with disruption spells like Spell Pierce and Spell Snare. By leveraging the UR color combination, the deck combines the speed of red aggro with the control elements of blue, creating a versatile and powerful strategy in the Modern format.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption through cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Dauthi Voidwalker, Grief, and Thoughtseize. The deck also includes some removal options with cards like Terminate and Fatal Push. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with its aggressive creatures and disruption spells while also having some resilience with cards like Not Dead After All and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. This deck utilizes a mix of creatures, spells, and lands to create a fast-paced and disruptive aggro strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly casting spells with cascade abilities to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of creatures and spells. By constantly cascading into powerful cards like "Crashing Footfalls" and "Dead / Gone," the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. The inclusion of counter spells like "Force of Negation" and removal spells like "Subtlety" helps to control the board while continuing to cascade into threats. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and disruptive, utilizing the cascade mechanic to its fullest potential.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the three Urza lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine, and Urza's Power Plant) to generate a large amount of mana and play powerful threats like The One Ring, Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck also includes control elements like Oblivion Stone, Dismember, and Warping Wail to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, there are cards like Ancient Stirrings and Expedition Map to help find key pieces of the deck quickly. Overall, the key concept is to ramp up mana quickly and dominate the game with powerful spells and creatures.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures to create powerful combos and synergies, utilizing tools like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for key pieces. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician serves as a central piece for generating advantage and controlling the board. Grist, the Hunger Tide provides additional creature tokens and value. The deck also includes support cards like Wall of Roots and Ignoble Hierarch for ramp and acceleration. The strategy involves efficiently tutoring for and utilizing creatures to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Indomitable Creativity in combination with high-costed creatures like Archon of Cruelty to cheat them into play from the top of the library or hand by sacrificing tokens created by spells like Dwarven Mine, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Strike It Rich. The deck also includes cards like Remand and Spell Pierce to protect the combo pieces and disrupt opponent's strategies. Wrenn and Six provide both card advantage and land recursion, while cards like Bitter Triumph and Persist offer additional synergy with sacrificing tokens or creatures.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with different abilities to create a strong toolbox for various situations. It uses cards like Chord of Calling to search for specific creatures, such as Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, to control the board and generate card advantage. The deck also includes combo pieces like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Agatha's Soul Cauldron, along with sacrifice outlets like Zulaport Cutthroat, to close out the game with a powerful combination of effects. Overall, the deck aims to be flexible and adaptable in dealing with a variety of opposing strategies.

This deck focuses on using cards that interact with +1/+1 counters to quickly overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures. By maximizing the number of counters placed on creatures through cards like Hardened Scales and Urza's Saga, combined with synergies from cards like Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp and Walking Ballista, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and finish games quickly. Agatha's Soul Cauldron and The Ozolith provide additional ways to manipulate counters and keep the momentum going. The deck is designed to be aggressive and efficient, aiming to outpace opponents and dominate the battlefield.

The key concept of this deck is to establish control over the game by utilizing counterspells, removal, and card draw. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain a dominant position on the battlefield. The deck includes a mix of cheap counterspells like Spell Pierce, higher-cost counters like Counterspell, and versatile removal options such as Flame Slash and Unholy Heat. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Archmage's Charm and Snapcaster Mage provide additional flexibility and value. The mana base is designed to support the deck's control elements with access to Blue and Red sources.
